name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: This quest forms a crucial step in a dwarven paladin's early trials with the Tome of Divinity, teaching selfless devotion to the Light through protecting the kingdom and rescuing comrades in need.
Uncovering Dark Iron infiltration right on the doorstep of Ironforge is vital for dwarven defense, proving to stubborn councilors that the ancestral enemy has breached Dun Morogh.
Exposing Dark Iron sabotage around Ironforge protects the dwarf capital and shores up the northern security of the Alliance against covert threats.

faq.answer: The quest is given by Narm Faulk, an injured dwarf who fell in battle against Dark Iron spies near Helm's Bed Lake. He sends you to retrieve enemy scripts and report back to his companion Muiredon Battleforge in Ironforge.
faq.q: Who gives The Tome of Divinity quest?

faq.answer: Muiredon Battleforge is a dwarf based in Ironforge. He scouted the Dark Iron spies alongside Narm Faulk near Helm's Bed Lake before returning to the city to recover from his wounds.

The Dark Iron Script contains written orders passed between Dark Iron spies and their captain near Helm's Bed Lake. It provides concrete evidence of hostile infiltration to show the skeptical Ironforge council.
faq.q: What is the Dark Iron Script?

faq.answer: Certain council members in Ironforge remain skeptical that Dark Iron dwarves have managed to infiltrate Dun Morogh. The recovered scripts prove their active movements and expose their clandestine plans.
faq.q: Why does the council in Ironforge need proof of the Dark Irons?

faq.answer: Helm's Bed Lake is located in eastern Dun Morogh, east of Kharanos. Dark Iron spies operate near a small house in the area, attempting to pass covert battle orders.
faq.q: Where are the Dark Iron spies located?

aliases: what does the tome of divinity teach
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity series tests an aspiring paladin's dedication to service, compassion, and courage. By aiding fallen comrades like Narm and defending Dun Morogh from insidious foes, the paladin proves worthy of wielding the Light.
faq.q: What role does this quest play for paladins?

sections.body: The Tome of Divinity guides young dwarven paladins along their spiritual calling. In this trial, aspiring champions are drawn into Dun Morogh's defense when an expedition against covert Dark Iron operatives goes awry near Helm's Bed Lake. Narm Faulk and Muiredon Battleforge attempted to ambush enemy scouts, but Narm fell wounded in the skirmish while Muiredon retreated to Ironforge to recover.
sections.title: A Trial of Service

sections.body: Despite growing rumors, several members of the ruling council in Ironforge refuse to acknowledge that Dark Iron infiltrators have penetrated Dun Morogh. By tracking down the spies near Helm's Bed and recovering a Dark Iron Script passed by their captain, the paladin secures undeniable proof of enemy movements and uncovers their brewing plots right outside the capital's gates.
sections.title: Proof for the Council

sections.body: Returning the intercepted orders to Muiredon Battleforge in Ironforge brings great relief. With Narm rescued and the recovered documents handed over for Muiredon's wife to present before the council, the paladin demonstrates both selfless bravery and devotion to the Light, protecting the dwarven realm from hidden treachery.
sections.title: Securing the Hearth

summary: The Tome of Divinity is a pivotal paladin trial centered on uncovering a covert Dark Iron infiltration in Dun Morogh. Aspiring paladins come to the aid of injured scouts Narm Faulk and Muiredon Battleforge, securing vital enemy orders to convince the skeptical council in Ironforge of the danger looming nearby.
